_comment: Hand-curated demo rules for two states beyond the flagship Sirsa/Haryana demo, citing pages that exist in the real ingested PDFs (see data/processed/nagaland/dimapur and data/processed/manipur/mpurimphaleast). Both source plans are short (<=19 pages) so in-range citations are easy to verify by hand: NL1_Dimapur_28.12.2013.pdf has 19 pages, MPUR_2_Imphal-east.pdf has 18. Condition text and actions are cleaned-up paraphrases of the real DACP table rows at the cited page (see the messy raw extractor output for the same pages in data/processed/<state>/<district>/*.json) -- this is a hand-curated demo fixture, not extractor output, so it is loaded as drafts, validated, then approved via ReviewService exactly like sirsa_demo_seed.json, never inserted as approved. Haryana/Sirsa is intentionally NOT duplicated here -- app.seed.seed_multi_state_demo loads it from sirsa_demo_seed.json directly (see that function's docstring).

fields.farming_situation: Plain land, moderately deep to deep fine/fine loamy soils (AES-II)
fields.condition: Early season drought (delayed onset) -- delay by 2 weeks (2nd to 3rd week of April)
fields.action: No change to the cropping system; sow in ridge and furrow with mulching under Line Department schemes / RKVY.

fields.farming_situation: Plain land, moderately deep to deep fine/fine loamy soils (AES-II)
fields.condition: Normal onset followed by 15-20 days dry spell after sowing leading to poor germination/crop stand etc.
fields.action: If germination is below 30%, re-sow; gap-fill with locally available seedlings; take up in-situ moisture conservation and mulching; life-saving irrigation if possible.

citation.source_text: Normal onset followed by 15-20 days dry spell after sowing leading to poor germination/crop stand etc.

fields.farming_situation: Plain land, moderately deep to deep fine/fine loamy soils (AES-II)
fields.action: If grain filling is severely affected, harvest for fodder; otherwise harvest at physiological maturity; prepare land for early rabi sowing of linseed, toria or buckwheat.

fields.condition: Early season drought (delayed onset) -- delay by 2 weeks (June 3rd week)
fields.action: No change to the cropping system; if onset delays further, advance-plough the field (April-May) and use a Dapog nursery with direct sowing of rice.

fields.condition: Normal onset followed by 15-20 days dry spell after sowing leading to poor germination/crop stand etc.
fields.action: No change to the cropping system; switch to direct-seeded paddy where germination is affected.

fields.condition: Mid season drought (long dry spell) at reproductive stage
fields.action: Provide light irrigation where possible; top-dress with urea (or foliar application) to support crop recovery.
